name: John Fujioka
bio: From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia John Mamoru Fujioka (June 29, 1925 – December 13, 2018) was an American actor of Japanese descent. He was particularly known for performing the role of a Japanese holdout soldier in The Last Flight of Noah's Ark, Who Finds a Friend Finds a Treasure, and American Ninja. He died in December 2018 at the age of 93. Description above from the Wikipedia article John Fujioka, licensed under CC-BY-SA, full list of contributors on Wikipedia.
